title: DynaFlare® Perimeter Light
subtitle: 6-LED perimeter warning light in multiple color configurations, including a smoked-lens option, for running board and rocker-panel mounting.
description: The Federal Signal DynaFlare® Perimeter Light is a 6-LED warning light engineered for running board and rocker-panel perimeter mounting on police vehicles, with low-profile, optically clear (or smoked) potted construction.
summary_bullets: Available in single and dual-color configurations
Designed for door, mirror, and bumper mounting

features: Multiple color configurations, including smoked-lens option
benefits: Running board / rocker-panel mounting keeps perimeter warning close to the ground plane
Smoked-lens variant available for a discreet daytime appearance
applications: Municipal police patrol — running board perimeter warning
Sheriff patrol — full-size SUV rocker-panel mounting
